verses.1: And he led me to the gate that faced the path of the ancients.
verses.2: And behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the direction of the east. Its sound was like the sound of rushing waters. The earth was illuminated by its glory.
verses.3: And as for the sight that I saw, it was a sight that I saw when I entered to attack the city. It was a sight that I saw as I walked along the river Kavar and towards Panei.
verses.4: And the glory of the LORD came into the temple through a door whose entrance was towards the east.
verses.5: A spirit carried me away, and he brought me to the inner courtyard. There, I saw the house filled with the glory of Jehovah.
verses.6: And I heard a voice from the house; there was a man standing beside me.
verses.7: And He said to me, “Son of Adam, declare the place where My throne will be, and the place where My feet will rest. This place shall be among the children of Israel forever. It shall never again be desecrated by those who worship the house of Israel, its sacred places, and their kings.”
verses.8: In their sin, they polluted my holiness. They desecrated the name of my sanctuary through their actions. I have eaten them with my own hands.
verses.9: Now let them take away their idols and the images of their kings from me. I will dwell among them forever.
verses.10: You, son of Adam, you who know the house of Israel. The houses will be destroyed from their foundations, and their plans will fail.
verses.11: And if they understand everything that was done regarding the structure and design of the house, as well as its contents and arrangements, and all its laws and regulations, then they will know them and write them down for themselves. They will also keep all its structures and laws intact.
verses.12: This is the law of the house on top of the mountain, throughout its entire territory. All around, there are holy places. Now, this is the law of the house.
verses.13: And these are the measurements of the altar: its height is “amah amah”, and its width as well. Its base and edges extend all the way to its base. This is the height of the altar.
verses.14: And from the bottom of the earth, up to the lowest level of support, there are two amotes and one amah. And from the smallest level of support, up to the highest level of support, there are four amotes and one amah.
verses.15: And the mountain is four amots; and from Aril, and on top of the peaks, there are four.
verses.16: And the area of Jerusalem is twelve cubits long, twelve cubits wide, and four cubits across.
verses.17: And the boundary of it is twenty-four cubits long, twenty-four cubits wide, and its circumference is half an amah. Its height around it is also one amah.
verses.18: And He said to Adam, “This is what the Lord God said: These are the laws regarding the sacrifice that must be offered on that day, so that it may be carried onto that altar and covered with blood.”
verses.19: And You gave to the priests those Levites who were descendants of Zadok. Come to Me, say, “Adonai Yahweh, serve Me!” For I am a son of dawn, for the day has come.
verses.20: And you took it from its wound, and you placed it on its four horns. You also placed it on its four sides, around its edge. Then you defiled it and desecrated it.
verses.21: And you took the sin offering and burned it in the proper place outside the holy place.
verses.22: And on the second day, they will bring forward white sheep as an offering for sin. They will also sin by sacrificing the altar, just as they sinned in the first day.
verses.23: In your pots, bring in pure wheat and lambs from the flock.
verses.24: And they brought them before Jehovah. Then the priests poured salt on them, and they were carried up to Jehovah.
verses.25: For seven days, one shall make a young goat as an offering for sin. And from the morning, one shall offer lambs and kids as offerings.
verses.26: For seven days, they shall cover the altar with cloth, and purify it. Then they shall fill its hands with offerings.
verses.27: And they spent those days. On the eighth day, the priests would perform their rituals upon the altar, as you have promised them. I have come to you, O LORD God.
